name: Kanera
description:
Kanera is project management software built around workspaces, boards, lists,
and cards. This connector gives Claude access to the same work you can see in
Kanera, so you can review and update projects in conversation instead of
switching apps.

Once connected, Claude can read your workspaces, boards, and cards, and — with
the write scope approved — create and update them. It covers cards and
assignments, due dates, labels, custom fields, checklists and checklist
templates, comments and mentions, notes, and attachments, plus board and list
configuration, automations, and reporting. Global Work views (My Cards, Team
Cards, and Portfolio) let Claude look across every board you can access rather
than one board at a time, and search reaches cards, notes, comments, and
attachment filenames.

Typical uses:

- Run a standup: ask what changed on a board since yesterday and what is now
  overdue.
- Triage a backlog: find unassigned or stale cards, then assign owners and set
  due dates.
- Review workload before planning: see what each teammate is carrying across
  projects.
- Turn a conversation into work: create a card with a checklist and due date
  from what you just discussed.
- Report on a period: summarize completed work across a workspace for a client
  or stakeholder update.

Authentication uses OAuth. You sign in to Kanera and approve the scopes you
want, and Claude acts as you — it can only see and change the boards your own
account can access. Read access is granted first and write access is optional,
so you can start read-only. Workspace administration is never available over
OAuth, regardless of your role in Kanera. You can review and revoke connected
agents at any time in your Kanera profile settings.

Requires a Kanera account. Works with Kanera's hosted service and with
self-hosted Kanera.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Kanera to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Kanera to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.kanera.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Kanera MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kanera lists 82 MCP tools, including kanera_add_checklist_item, kanera_add_comment, kanera_add_note_attachment, kanera_add_note_link, kanera_archive_card, kanera_archive_list_cards, kanera_bulk_add_checklist_items, kanera_bulk_add_comments, kanera_bulk_archive_cards, kanera_bulk_delete_comments, kanera_bulk_duplicate_cards, and kanera_bulk_move_cards.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Kanera?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Kanera in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Kanera requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Kanera is developed by Happen Software. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
